notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33774501/44da7a8c8393880335e4ad9871ca13b9bed76c9e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: v1.0.18 - New upgrades!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33774501/de144462a274e6c01b0864320ff94ac5251c1ec4.jpg[/img]

The Steam Summer Sale is over, but Starport Delta is still available on discount in the [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/store/promo/space-sale/]Humble Space Sale[/url] this week! We've also had some new & recent positive feedback for the game, and we're looking forward to the next steps for Starport Delta.

The big change in this update is two new second-tier upgrades for both Oxygen Plants and Food Farms - you can see a sneak peek of these in the image above! Following on from adding "Normal" and "Challenge" difficulty modes to the first four missions in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/888130/announcements/detail/2237673324855239167]v1.0.16[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/888130/announcements/detail/2515772501328908019]v1.0.17[/url], this update adds the same selectors to missions 5 & 6. We've also given you the ability to compliment your residents any time you want, some UI updates and more. Soon we'll have difficulty modes for the rest of the campaign, and we're looking forward to giving players more choices and more of what they want to see in the game.

This update also includes bug fixes and requests from our community, including adding any build cost shortfall to the information window so you don't have to do the math and work out what you need. We welcome feedback of all kinds through the [url=https://discord.gg/9Fr6sye]Starport Delta Discord[/url], the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/888130/discussions/0/2153224747925597242/]discussion boards[/url], [url=https://starportdelta.com]support site[/url] or regular old email. We've also added a new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/cloudfire-studios-support/]Cloudfire Studios Support[/url] user here on Steam as another avenue to connect with us. We read everything we can to help improve your experience of our game.

If you're interested in seeing Starport Delta in your language, make sure to let us know! We have a dedicated localization requests channel on the [url=https://discord.gg/9Fr6sye]Starport Delta Discord[/url] and we're listening on all other channels as well.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33774501/e891545ced68c20497402fa4d60ab4be6b3e7539.jpg[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/2445966074571282888]The Summer Sale is here![/url] Starport Delta is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/888130/Starport_Delta/]25% off during the Summer Sale[/url], so now is a good time to grab a copy for you or a friend! We can't wait to see which reviewers start getting [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/howitworks#CommunityAwards]Community Awards[/url] as well!

Following on from adding "Normal" and "Challenge" difficulty modes to the first two missions in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/888130/announcements/detail/2237673324855239167]v1.0.16[/url], this update adds the same selectors to missions 3 & 4. If there's a mission you're stuck on or feel is too challenging right now, please [url=https://discord.gg/9Fr6sye]let us know[/url]!

The small resident ships flying from housing complexes to the port make stations feel more alive, and we're looking forward to updating these moving forward and adding more to make each station more vibrant.

notes.title: v1.0.15 - Sandbox updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33774501/b850cd3c54089e6dc5a5071bd276cfd4c9eebbf5.jpg[/img]

This update focuses mainly on our sandbox mode, where players can design and build their stations in a more free-play environment. We've pushed the previous 'easy' sandbox up to being 'normal' and added a new 'easy' sandbox which is closer to an earlier version of the easy sandbox, with some additional tweaks. The new 'easy' mode only has space pirate attacks and meteor showers for the disasters. The starting resources have been scaled across all sandbox modes, and we've changed other parts of various events like damage from meteors to how fast a repair drone can repair a building. We've also added in some minor bug fixes pointed out by the [url=https://discord.gg/9Fr6sye]Starport Delta Discord community[/url]. If you have any ideas, we want to hear them! We read every bit of feedback, everywhere we can (even if we have to rely on Google Translate a bit).

We're going to be looking at increasing the options in the game around difficulty to improve playability particularly for casual players. We'd like to see more players getting further along in the campaign, so if there's a mission you're stuck on, or you feel is too challenging, please [url=https://discord.gg/9Fr6sye]let us know[/url]!

We're actively seeking localization feedback from our non-English-speaking players! If you spot something we have a dedicated channel for translations feedback on the [url=https://discord.gg/9Fr6sye]Starport Delta Discord[/url], and we welcome feedback through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/888130/discussions/0/2153224747925597242/]discussion boards[/url], [url=https://starportdelta.com]support site[/url] or regular old email.

If you're interested in seeing Starport Delta in your language, make sure to let us know! We have a dedicated localization requests channel on the [url=https://discord.gg/9Fr6sye]Starport Delta Discord[/url] and we're listening on all other channels as well.

Here are the details of the last couple of updates.

[h2]v1.0.15[/h2] [list]
[*] add new easy sandbox mode (previous easy is now normal)
[*] add new sandbox leaderboard
[*] add income from evacuated population
[*] scale repair rates by sandbox difficulty for drones

[*] scale damage and target count rates by sandbox difficulty for space pirate attacks

[*] add Unreal Engine logo to credits

[/list]
[h2]What's next[/h2] [list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33774501/576d5a39aa485172a4fa8332e1dbe0cddde600dc.jpg[/img]

As the team settles in to work on our regular updates, we know that a lot of players use Discord! We've added support for their Rich Presence to show what mode you're playing in Starport Delta. notes.content:

One the of the most common bits of feedback that we've had from players so far has been the request for controls around time.
